content.text: By the end of this lesson, you should be able to:
Define oxidation and reduction in terms of oxygen

Explain why oxidation and reduction always occur together (redox)
are fundamental chemical processes that always occur together. Understanding these reactions helps explain many important processes, from rusting to respiration to metal extraction.
